title: Containment Re-Staging Charges — Installation Jobs
content:
**Containment re-staging after failed-access visits — Installation Jobs**

Containment staged for a visit the customer did not give access to is staged again. When the lead-safe fee of an **Installation Jobs** record is priced, a re-staging charge follows the failed-access fees the job's charges carry — job charges of kind failed-access fee recorded on the job:

| Failed-access fees among the job's charges | Re-staging charge |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | $120.00 |
| exactly one | $60.00 |
| none | none |

The charge is a single amount for the job, added to the fee.

## Cases (hypothetical jobs)

- Two failed-access fees on the job's charges: $120.00.
- One failed-access fee on the job's charges: $60.00.
- Late reschedule fees only, and no failed-access fee: none.
